svg.title: Heavy-duty 7-ply triple-wall corrugated box strapped on a pallet
svg.desc: A large triple-wall (7-ply, C+B+C flute) corrugated box on a wooden pallet, secured with PP straps and metal seals and protected by corner boards, with a heavy-load warning, a pallet label and handling marks. A magnifier shows the three fluted walls.
